_comment: The live sale, as data. scripts/verify-prices.mjs renders this into README.md between the SALE markers and REMOVES it once `end` passes, so a finished sale can't sit at the top of the page claiming to be live. Set to null (literally the word null on the `sale` key) when nothing is running. `codes` may be empty for a sale with no coupon code; `beatsEveryday` controls whether the callout says the sale beats RUSHABH30 or spells out when it doesn't.

sale.name: Switch & Save flash sale
sale.headline: 40% off a certification exam plus an extra 20% off THRIVE-ONE Annual, when bought as a bundle
sale.bannerAlt: Linux Foundation Switch & Save, September 9 to 11, 2026: 40% off certifications plus 20% off THRIVE-ONE Annual when bundled. Unlimited learning, subscriber exclusives, SkillCred All-Access, plus an industry-recognized certification.
sale.noCodeNote: No code this time. The bundle prices on the landing page already include both cuts, so you pick a bundle and check out.
sale.compare: This only beats `RUSHABH30` if you wanted the THRIVE-ONE Annual subscription anyway (unlimited courses, SkillCred All-Access, subscriber extras). If you only want the exam, `RUSHABH30` is still cheaper: CKA alone is about $311 with it, against $553 for the CKA bundle. Sale prices don't stack with `RUSHABH30`.

bundles.label: CKA, CKAD, CKS, LFCS or CNPE + THRIVE-ONE Annual: ~~$805~~ **$553**
KCNA, KCSA, PCA, OTCA, CGOA, ICA, CCA, CAPA, LFCA and the other associate exams + THRIVE-ONE Annual: ~~$610~~ **$423**

sale.dateCaveat: On the dates: the offer terms end at 23:59 UTC on September 11, 2026, which is 5:29 AM IST on September 12. The marketing copy and the terms agree this time, so September 11 is the last day to buy.
sale.terms: New, individual purchases only, not renewals, and it can't be combined with other discounts. Bundle prices above were read off the landing page on September 9, 2026 and are hand-checked, not part of the automated price check.
